title: Payoff Good-Through Period for Homes Listed or Under Contract with Hearthstone Home Sales
content:
**Affiliate coordination note — Home Purchase Financing payoffs on homes in an In-Place Home Resale file**

When the financed home is being sold in place through Hearthstone Home Sales, its In-Place Home Resale file — the file for the home that shows Hearthstone Home Finance as lienholder — bears on how long a payoff figure is good:

- Where the home is under contract in a Hearthstone Home Sales resale file whose closing date falls within 30 days of the statement date, the good-through period runs to the closing date plus 2 days — that is, the days from the statement date to the closing date, plus 2.
- Where the home is listed in such a file but not yet under contract, the good-through period is 30 days.
- In every other case this note sets no good-through period.

"Within 30 days" includes a closing exactly 30 days after the statement date. The file's status (listed, under contract) and its closing date are read from the In-Place Home Resale file.

### Cases (hypothetical statement date 2026-05-04)

| Resale file | Closing date | Good-through period |
|---|---|---|
| under contract | 2026-05-28 (24 days away) | 26 days |
| under contract | 2026-06-03 (30 days away) | 32 days |
| under contract | 2026-06-04 (31 days away) | not set by this note |
| listed, not under contract | — | 30 days |
| no resale file for the home | — | not set by this note |
